text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I'm way too excited for this! Can 
the Japan Cup hurry up and start already?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
This lineup is way too stacked! First 
there's the "Monster" Oguri Cap, right? 
And then the "White Lightning" Tamamo 
Cross!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't forget an important horse girl!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The most gorgeous Umamusume of all! Gold 
City is definitely gonna win today!!
(Waaaaaah...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Whoa, things are really getting heated.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
When they hype things up that much, I 
can't just sit here quietly and wait.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I've been wondering for a while now, 
but are you treating me like I'm 
hot-tempered? I'm not getting impatient—"
"Run true to yourself."
"‘Go run true to yourself.’"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, you've always said 
that, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"To run true to myself... Always, 
always..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, why did you let me keep running?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"People kept throwing annoying complaints 
at me, and even Manager was cornering me 
with unreasonable demands."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...There were times I completely ignored 
what you wanted, too. I know that must 
have been hard on you."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
“And yet, even through all that... you 
kept me running. Why?”

"I promise you, no matter what happens, 
I'll keep you running."

"No matter what happens, I promise I'll 
keep you running."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Is that all?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Not for me, not for yourself, not for the 
fans... not for anything like that?
choice_data_list:
Because I knew how badly you wanted to 
run.
Because I knew you really wanted to run.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... Seriously, you're out of your 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Someone so smotheringly passionate and 
persistent. I'm really, truly glad... 
you're my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Idiot. It's way too early to be grinning 
like that.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
When the race is over, greet me with a 
smile, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—I'm gonna go out there and run like 
myself!
